steps: The midsegment theorem states that the segment joining the midpoints of two sides is parallel to the third side and half its length.
The third side is 66, so the midsegment is 66 ÷ 2 = 33.
It is parallel to the third side, which follows because the midsegment creates a triangle similar to the original with ratio 1:2.
